review.notes: Full review after a 175-line repair. r12's four findings repaired. New P1: GeometricMorphism.IsEssential is defined as f.inverse.IsLeftAdjoint, which every geometric morphism satisfies through f.adj (Lean probe elaborates), so isEssential_iff_preservesProducts (5.6) and Roos's theorem (6.5) are false as stated and refuted by the README's own Checks on Sh(Q) and Sh(R); repair is Functor.IsRightAdjoint. P3: 4.4 Check 3 identifies Comma Φ (1 G) with Pointed(G) instead of F × Pointed(G); Isbell 1972 locator for countable products (remark after 3.12); How to read the build still names only the first local cohomology sheaf. Gate: worker OK on every check; depcheck 244 roadmaps, 0 problems; diff outside folder empty. Probe: all 40 sorried theorems fail one tactic; #check types of the four new declarations match the README. Sources read: hofmann-lawson1978 4.1, isbell1981 Thms 1-2, isbell1972 (OCR) pp. 14, 18, 22, 30, 31, stone1948 Thm 3, bannister2024 Cor 3.13 (scratch manifest). Pinned declarations opened for Functor.IsLeftAdjoint/IsRightAdjoint, Additive, Opens.compl, HasEnoughPoints, Point.Hom, Sublocale, Comma, and Tau Ceti supportedSections/HSheaf. Ownership: HigherToposTheory #1901 declares CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckTopos without citing this roadmap (its repair); TotallyDistributiveTopoi #1927 is a consumer. Paywalled books (SGA 4, Elephant, MM, Stone Spaces, KS) not verifiable.
